title: Crafters Battlegrounds
description:
Turns the Minecraft world in a battleground, with custom powers and runes. 
Welcome, to a new world
body:
![Ufficial logo.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70a7a4f39a6d8009f1e94884c2f660eb3b023d1b.png)

📖Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------
This datapack allows you to use the powers of Sound, Fire & Necromancy,
bend the powers of the runes, use them to your advance, 
fight to the top and show who you really are.
Welcome, to a new world.

This is a project that has been worked on for the past 2 years.
It was made by a single person. The datapack itself is part of a series
of datapack and upcoming projects, the goes by the name "Sweet Highs".

Most of the datapack features and functions itself are explained in game,
with both a guide book, a start promt, and intelligent tooltips when hovering
on the attacks itself.

⬇️Installation
---------------------------------------------------------------
To install the pack, you'll need to enable both the "cb.script" and
the "Crafters Battlegrounds" datapacks, the "cb.script" one is not mandatory,
and will break the game on occasions.
Unfortunaly, using Optifine Shaders, may break the vanilla minecart mob model.

---------------------------------------------------------------
If you wanna support the datapacks saga, or the creator itself, you
